definitions.name: W1D.BDELTA
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to a Vector of +1 per opener and -1 per closer

definitions.name: W1D.BPASS
definitions.note: one pass deleting every adjacent () and [] pair from a String

definitions.name: W1D.BSTRIP
definitions.body: W1D.BPASS W1D.BPASS W1D.BPASS W1D.BPASS W1D.BPASS W1D.BPASS
definitions.note: delete adjacent matched bracket pairs until none remain (Strings up to 12 chars); '' iff balanced

definitions.name: W1D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, the first one among ties

definitions.name: W1D.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'W' BIND ' ' W 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of words with single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: W1D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT CS 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: a non-empty word with its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased

definitions.name: W1D.MODEFIRST
definitions.body: TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES W1D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: most frequent element of a Vector; ties go to the one appearing first

definitions.name: W1D.NAMES
definitions.note: first element of each row of a Vector of pairs

definitions.name: W1D.AMTS
definitions.note: second element of each row of a Vector of pairs

definitions.name: W1D.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L W1D.NAMES L W1D.AMTS GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs to a Record name -> summed amount, names in first-appearance order

definitions.name: W1D.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: a Record as a Vector of [ key value ] pairs in key order

definitions.name: W1D.RLE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'P' BIND P 0 GET X EQ 'SM' BIND A -1 DROP A 2 COLLECT 0 1 SM SELECT GET X P 1 GET 1 ADD 1 SM SELECT 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT ] FOLD
definitions.note: run-length encoding of a non-empty Vector: [ [ value count ] ... ] per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: W1D.TRUERUN
definitions.body: 0 [ 'T' BIND 'C' BIND C 1 ADD 0 T SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest run of adjacent TRUE lanes in a Vector of truths (0 if none)

definitions.name: W1D.RUNSTARTS
definitions.body: 'T' BIND T FALSE 1 COLLECT T -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND
definitions.note: Vector of truths marking the first lane of each run of TRUE in a Vector of truths

definitions.name: W1D.PRESENT
definitions.note: the non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order

definitions.name: W1D.ABS
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 0 X SUB X X 0 LT SELECT

definitions.name: W1D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when even)
